duty_overlay_scope: Current disposition after P3-A. The byte-preserved P3-01 duty matrix remains the historical contract; gate readiness is not blanket achievement of its duties.

duties.scope: A bounded producer and active-domain/default policy are required; this gate supplies no logical constructor or free truth/consistency oracle.
Checked theory-conditional resolution/refutation, interpreted truth under its bridge, unresolved, failed, conflicted and stale statuses remain distinct.
Existing finite assessment states respect actually represented Boolean constraints under their declared semantics; bounded construction and unprocessed arithmetic closure are not supplied.
Version-matched received evidence requires eligible updates or stale status under the applicable bridge; implementation is future work and old forecasts remain immutable.
No pointwise convergence or eventual correctness theorem is established for a new learner.
Anticipatory performance on a declared recurring family remains a separate target with charged shortcuts.
Calibration needs its own selection, weighting, feedback and resolution hypotheses; finite statistics and regret are insufficient.
The fixed-expert full-feedback comparison and its output/loss assumptions are available; no new regret or all-efficient-trader guarantee is inferred.
Exogenous delayed feedback and action-dependent paid discovery remain different contracts.
Payoffs, exact subjective expectations, fallible estimates, certified intervals and realized losses are separately typed; learned error warrants remain future obligations.

duties.owner: P3-02 complete; later consumers preserve scope
duties.scope: P3-02 characterizes full-law, specified-target, interval and decision services for its stated sources/calibrations, with constructive repairs and collisions; arbitrary value carriers are not covered.
The inherited 2-epsilon action-regret bound requires uniform cost error in common units; no learner error rate is established.
Hard resource vectors and materially different construction, precision, proof, access and checking costs require concrete closure in the later method.
Model truth, adequacy, usefulness, selection and retention are distinct; the ordinary comparator receives the same library and access. No plurality advantage is established.
Conditional native reuse and P3-02 retention/repair results preserve source, unit, objective and access premises; actual logical-update application remains future work.
Conditioning, token intervention, shared or actor-only replacement, repair and genuine counterpossible evaluation remain distinct operations.
Equal observational laws may have different counterfactual consequences; structural or policy information must be supplied.
Existence, optimality, coverage of minimizing consequences and one declared policy selection are separate services.
Genuine counterpossibles must preserve the topic while declaring and defending any exceptional evaluation rules.
Representational equivalence must preserve operations, admitted positions, evidence, actions and costs. P3-02 supplies finite information adaptations; numerical relabeling alone is insufficient.
A versioned staged self-model is distinct from report-dependent feedback; proper scoring under an exogenous law does not solve the endogenous case.
